020import net.tnemc.menu.folia.FoliaMenuHandler;
021import net.tnemc.paper.PaperCore;
022import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
023import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
024import org.bukkit.plugin.java.JavaPlugin;
025
026import java.util.ArrayList;
027import java.util.List;
028import java.util.UUID;
029import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
030import java.util.function.Consumer;
031
032/**
033 * FoliaCore
034 *
035 * @author creatorfromhell
036 * @since 0.1.3.4
037 */
038public class FoliaCore extends PaperCore {
039
040  public FoliaCore(final JavaPlugin plugin) {
041
042    super(plugin);
043  }
044
045  @Override
046  public void registerMenuHandler() {
047
048    this.menuHandler = new FoliaMenuHandler(plugin, true);
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  public boolean canAccessInventory(final UUID identifier) {
053
054    final Player player = Bukkit.getPlayer(identifier);
055    //Folia also reports ownership on its shutdown thread, once region ticking has halted.
056    return player != null && Bukkit.isOwnedByCurrentRegion(player);
057  }
058
059  @Override
060  public CompletableFuture<Void> snapshotOnlinePlayers(final Consumer<UUID> snapshot) {
061
062    final List<CompletableFuture<Void>> pending = new ArrayList<>();
063    for(final Player player : Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers()) {
064      final CompletableFuture<Void> result = new CompletableFuture<>();
065      pending.add(result);
066      final Runnable task = ()->{
067        try {
068          snapshot.accept(player.getUniqueId());
069          result.complete(null);
070        } catch(final Throwable failure) {
071          result.completeExceptionally(failure);
072        }
073      };
074      if(Bukkit.isOwnedByCurrentRegion(player)) {
075        task.run();
076      } else {
077        scheduleSnapshot(player, task, result);
078      }
079    }
080    return CompletableFuture.allOf(pending.toArray(CompletableFuture[]::new));
081  }
082
083  private void scheduleSnapshot(final Player player, final Runnable task, final CompletableFuture<Void> result) {
084
085    try {
086      //Retired players are snapshotted by PlayerQuitEvent before their entity scheduler is retired.
087      if(!player.getScheduler().execute(plugin, task, ()->result.complete(null), 1L)) {
088        result.complete(null);
089      }
090    } catch(final RuntimeException failure) {
091      result.completeExceptionally(failure);
092    }
093  }
094
095  @Override
096  public CompletableFuture<Void> runPlayerTask(final UUID identifier, final Runnable action) {
097
098    final Player player = Bukkit.getPlayer(identifier);
099    final CompletableFuture<Void> result = new CompletableFuture<>();
100    final Runnable task = ()->{
101      try {
102        action.run();
103        result.complete(null);
104      } catch(final Throwable failure) {
105        result.completeExceptionally(failure);
106      }
107    };
108    try {
109      if(player == null) {
110        Bukkit.getGlobalRegionScheduler().execute(plugin, task);
111      } else if(Bukkit.isOwnedByCurrentRegion(player)) {
112        task.run();
113      } else if(!player.getScheduler().execute(plugin, task,
114                                              ()->result.completeExceptionally(new IllegalStateException("Player retired before task")), 1L)) {
115        result.completeExceptionally(new IllegalStateException("Player scheduler retired"));
116      }
117    } catch(final RuntimeException failure) {
118      result.completeExceptionally(failure);
119    }
120    return result;
121  }
122}
